# Canonical chromosome test fixtures

These files contain only small, test-only chromosome dictionary excerpts; they
contain no reference sequence or genome index. The hg19/GRCh37 and hg38/GRCh38
canonical lengths are factual assembly metadata, with noncanonical names added
only to test exclusion. The Ensembl fixture uses the corresponding unprefixed
GRCh38 names. `hg38_ucsc.fa.ann` is a synthetic minimal BWA annotation-shaped
fixture carrying the same names and lengths.

The fixtures may be redistributed with TrESFlow under the repository license.
